sections.heading: Redesign or rebuild?

sections.body: Not every outdated site needs a rebuild. illwerke vkw did.

faq.question: Will a redesign hurt my SEO?
faq.question_de: Verliere ich bei einem Relaunch mein Google-Ranking?
faq.answer: Not if every old URL redirects to its new page.
faq.answer_de: Nicht, wenn jede alte URL auf ihre neue Seite weiterleitet.

acf_fields.cta_text: Tell me which site it is and what bothers you about it. Replies within a day.
